notes.title: Festive Update now LIVE!
notes.notes:
Color Connect 2021 Christmas update now available. Once you have earned 20+ stars on the main game you will unlock the Christmas environment and levels - accessed through the main menu level select screen by clicking on the gift box. It is our present to you this year.

12 new unique levels with varying difficulty. Help to build the festive world around you earning stars as you go. Some real surprises along the way add approximately 1hr of gameplay to the Color Connect main game. The best part... It's free!!!

We wish you all a very merry Christmas and a happy new year from all at Sandford Tech.
